title: Unmasking Hiring Bias: Platform Data Analysis and Controlled Experiments on Bias in Online Freelance Marketplaces via RAG-LLM Generated Contents

bias_targets.methodology: Conducting controlled user hiring experiments using RAG-LLM generated freelance profiles with gender-distinct names, and performing statistical regression analysis on real-world platform review/rating data using AI-inferred gender from user avatars.

Conducting head-to-head simulated hiring choices using synthetic profiles with regionally distinct names (US vs. India), and analyzing observational platform data to compare post-project evaluations between US and Indian freelancers.
